definitions.explanation: An honorific title for members of the imperial or a royal family other than the emperor, empress, and empress dowager, who are addressed as {陛下|へいか}. Placed after a name or title, or used alone in address.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皇太子|こうたいし}→皇太子：15717_koutaishi⟧{殿下|でんか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦お{見|み}えになった→お見えになる：17274_omieninaru⟧。
examples.english: His Imperial Highness the Crown Prince has arrived.

examples.japanese: {秋篠宮|あきしののみや}{殿下|でんか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{式典|しきてん}→式典：09526_shikiten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: His Imperial Highness Prince Akishino attended the ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{英国|えいこく}→英国：14152_eikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{王子|おうじ}→王子：01904_ouji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「{殿下|でんか}」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{敬称|けいしょう}→敬称：17543_keishou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけて⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: Britain's princes are referred to in the Japanese press with the honorific title "Highness."

notes:
Written as a title after the name: 〜{殿下|でんか}. Used alone, {殿下|でんか} addresses the person directly ("Your Highness").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{皇太子|こうたいし}→皇太子：15717_koutaishi⟧{殿下|でんか}: His Imperial Highness the Crown Prince
- {妃|ひ}{殿下|でんか}: Her Imperial Highness (a prince's wife)
- 〜{宮|みや}{殿下|でんか}: Prince 〜

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{陛下|へいか}→陛下：14566_heika⟧: Your/His Majesty — for the emperor, empress, and empress dowager
- ⟦{電化|でんか}→電化：32080_denka⟧: electrification — same reading, unrelated
